title: Beeps non-stop and alarm goes off randomly
text: Beeps non-stop and alarm goes off randomly. The alarm goes off for no reason and the clock beeps constantly. This is nice to look at but I don't have the alarm set, but it goes off and then it won't stop beeping. Seems like it doesn't work the way it should.

product_metadata.title: Housbay Digital Alarm Clocks for Bedrooms - Handy Night Light, Large Numbers with Display Dimmer, Dual USB Chargers, 12/24hr, Outlets Powered Compact Clock for Nightstand, Desk, Shelf
features: 【LARGE 5.3’’ LED DISPLAY WITH 1.8’’ JUMBO DIGITS】- This large led display makes it easy for anyone to check the time from across the room. The full range dimmer facilitates time viewing at all times. Great choice for your bedside and kids’ room

【HANDY 2-COLOR NIGHT LIGHT】- White and orange. The brightness-adjustable night light will come in handy especially for baby's nighttime feedings and diaper changes, comforting child to sleep with gentle light on and lighting up the path to bathroom
【HANDY DUAL USB CHARGERS】- It comes with dual USB ports at the back to charge your phones, tablets, or other 5V electronics

【EASY TO OPERATE】- The buttons are large enough and easy to operate. You can easily snooze it and turn the nightlight on/off. A handy feature is that you can silence the alarm by pressing any of the buttons at the back. This feature is unique to this clock
【OUTLET POWERED AND BACKUP】- It’s a plug-in alarm clock and allows for backup. The LED display won't show on backup mode but the alarm and time settings will be saved
